• 1910: Incorporated as Tata Hydroelectric Power Supply Company • 1915: 1 st Hydro power generating station (40 MW) commissioned at Khopoli, followed by Bhivpuri (1922) and Bhira (1927) 1910-1955 • 1956-65: 3 units of 62.5 MW each and 4th thermal unit of 150 MW capacity at Trombay commissioned • 1977: 150 MW pumped storage at Bhira upgraded • 1984: 500 MW-5 th Unit established at Trombay, to supply uninterrupted supply to Mumbai • 1991: 1 st Solar Cell manufacturing capacity is set up by TPSSL in collaboration with BP Solar 1956-2000 2001-2005 • 2001: Commissioned first wind asset of 17 MW at Supa Maharashtra • 2002: Took over distribution of Delhi, later renamed as TPDDL a JV between Tata Power (51%) and Delhi Government (49%) • 2003: Entered a JV with PGCIL, to develop a 1,200 Km long transmission line to bring electricity from Bhutan to Delhi • Completed acquisition of 30% stake in Indonesian Coal Mines: KPC Arutmin & Indo Coal for $1.15 Bn • Tata Power - Mundra signed PPA with 5 states (Gujarat, Maharashtra, Punjab, Haryana & Rajasthan) • Industrial Energy Limited (IEL), a JV formed between Tata Power (74%) and Tata Steel (26%) to meet power requirements for Tata Steel 2007 • Commissioned first solar asset of 3 MW at Mulshi, Maharashtra • Unit 1 of 525 MW Maithon Power Limited (MPL) commissioned 2011 • 2012: Commissioned 2nd unit of 525 MW in MPL • 2013: 5 units of 800 MW each at Mundra UMPP commissioned, the first super critical technology in India • 2013: Acquired 26% share in the Indonesian coal mine BSSR for $ 152 Mn 2012-2013 • 2014: Entered into agreement to sell 30% stake in Arutmin for $401 Mn • 2015: Commissioned the 126 MW Dagachhu Hydro Power Corporation in Bhutan 2014-2015 2016-2017 • 2016: Acquired 1,010MW operational RE assets of Welspun, renamed it to Walwhan Renewable Energy Ltd (WREL) • 2016: Resurgent Power JV formed by Tata Power and ICICI Venture to acquire stressed assets in Indian Power Sector. Tata Power holds 26% stake in Resurgent Power • 2017:Tata Power Ajmer Distribution Limited (TPADL) formed to take over supply and distribution of Ajmer • Resurgent Power Ventures acquired 75.01% equity stake of Prayagraj Power Generation Limited

L&T bags ( Significant*) order from Noida Metro for Aqua Line Extension Mumbai, November 9, 2026: The Heavy Civil Infrastructure business vertical of L&T has secured an order from Noida Metro Rail Corporation Ltd for part design and construction of the Noida Metro Aqua Line Extension Project. The project scope encompasses part design and construction of a 15.1 km elevated viaduct from Botanical Garden to Noida Sector-142, and from Depot Station to Boraki. The scope includes the construction of 10 elevated metro stations, including architectural finishes. Noida Metro Aqua Line Extension is poised to become a landmark urban transit project, significantly enhancing regional connectivity and commuter accessibility. The project will play a crucial role in supporting Noida's expanding urban landscape and is to be completed within a stringent timeline of 36 months. About Larsen & Toubro: Larsen & Toubro is a USD 32 billion Indian multinational engaged in EPC Projects, Hi-Tech Manufacturing, Products and Services, operating across diverse domains and multiple geographies.
